info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Channel Activity Insights API
info.description: The Channel Activity Insights API provides businesses with valuable analytics regarding customer interactions across various banking channels. By utilizing this API, developers can access detailed reports on channel performance and user engagement metrics, enabling data-driven decision-making. Typical users include banking analysts and product managers looking to optimize operational strategies. This API supports enhanced understanding of customer behavior and channel efficiency, facilitating targeted improvements and service enhancements.
